thread:
Maria Chen (Product): ok folks — planning sync: we need to finalize scope for the authz work next quarter. customers asking for per-project scoped API keys + org-level RBAC + audit trails. want to align on priority and launch criteria.
Ajay Patel (EngSec): +1. can we separate into two deliverables: 1) Scoped API keys (fast win) 2) Full RBAC + role management (bigger).
Ben Torres (Eng-Platform): agree. scoped keys are lower risk for infra. RBAC needs UI, policy engine, and migration.
Sofia Li (SRE): also need rollout & telemetry plan. scoped keys could be toggled per-org via feature flag. must track auth failures + token misuse counters.
Kai Nguyen (PM): proposed prioritization matrix: impact (customer revenue + security), effort (eng + infra), risk. can we fill that quickly?
Rachel O'Neil (Customer Success): Acme and Helix both escalated. Acme wants per-project keys that can be rotated by their devs (no org-admin touch). Helix asked for RBAC so they can separate infra and app teams.
Maria Chen (Product): ok so acceptance criteria draft (first pass):
```
- Scoped API keys v1 acceptance criteria:
  - API keys can be created with an optional project_id scope
  - Keys without project_id remain global (backcompat)
  - Keys can be rotated and revoked via API
  - Audit log entry created for create/rotate/revoke with actor, org, project, timestamp
  - Customers can opt-in per org
- RBAC v1 acceptance criteria:
  - Basic roles: org-admin, project-admin, project-developer
  - Policy enforcement at API layer for resource-level access
  - Role assignment APIs + audit logs
  - Migration path for existing API keys (mapping guidance)
```
Ajay Patel (EngSec): couple of edge cases to add: what happens when project is deleted but keys reference it? need clear behavior (deny or reassign). also cross-org token leaks.
Ben Torres (Eng-Platform): technical note: token format change will require a minor version bump if we embed scope in token itself. alternative: store scope in token metadata table and keep opaque token. prefer opaque for now (no breaking changes).
Sofia Li (SRE): rollout idea: beta with feature flag + telemetry for 2 weeks; promote once error rate stable and rotation events normal. add a fallback path to accept global keys for 30s if project lookup DB is down.
Kai Nguyen (PM): prioritization decision: scoped keys (P0) — directly unblocks multiple customers and low infra effort; RBAC (P1) — bigger, schedule in Q2 after scoped keys and policy eval engine prototyping. thoughts?
Rachel O'Neil (Customer Success): customers ok with staged approach if we commit to an RBAC roadmap and share timelines. Acme would adopt scoped keys ASAP.
Maria Chen (Product): launch criteria proposal for scoped keys: 1) feature enabled on hosted AND dedicated 2) docs + migration guide published 3) audit logging validated with synthetic tests 4) 2 enterprise customers signed up in beta 5) no severe incidents in 7 days post-beta.
Ajay Patel (EngSec): add security review sign-off and threat model doc to launch criteria. also KMS integration for key material should be validated.
Ben Torres (Eng-Platform): I'll prep a small schema patch for token metadata and a migration script. estimate 3w for implementation + 1w for integration tests.
Sofia Li (SRE): I'll draft the telemetry dashboard: failed auth by org/project, rotation cadence, audit log volume.
Maria Chen (Product): action items: Ajay write RFC for scoped keys + edge cases, Ben prototype metadata-backed tokens, Sofia telemetry dashboards, Rachel collect customer acceptance language. Kai consolidate prioritization matrix and update roadmap. I'll own launch criteria doc.
Kai Nguyen (PM): I'll slot scoped keys in roadmap as next sprint block and add RBAC as follow-up epic with placeholders for policy engine and UI.
deploy-bot: deployment queued: auth-service/schema-migration -> staging (build 0.42.1) :rocket:
Ben Torres (Eng-Platform): :thumbsup: posting RFC draft later today.
Ajay Patel (EngSec): would like a short RFC template section calling out acceptance tests. propose adding this to PRD:
```
Acceptance tests (automated):
- create key scoped to project X, call project-scoped endpoint => 200
- same key call another project's resource => 403
- rotate key => old key invalid within 60s
- revoke key => immediate 401
- audit record exists for each action
```
Maria Chen (Product): perfect. small ask: include migration guidance for existing orgs that embed keys in CI secrets (docs + checklist).
Rachel O'Neil (Customer Success): I'll draft the onboarding checklist for customers and gather metrics we should report during beta.
Kai Nguyen (PM): timeline callout: scoped keys MVP -> dev 3w, QA 1w, beta 2w, launch -> estimate 6 weeks from start. RBAC epic kickoff after scoped keys GA.
Sofia Li (SRE): please remember to add chaos/failure tests for project DB downtime to ensure fallback behavior.
Maria Chen (Product): noted. thanks everyone — let's reconvene Friday to review Ajay's RFC and Ben's prototype notes.
Ben Torres (Eng-Platform): will share branch and initial migration plan before EOD.
Ajay Patel (EngSec): sending RFC link in thread once published.
Rachel O'Neil (Customer Success): ping me if you want customer-specific use-cases to include.
Maria Chen (Product): end of thread: thanks — this gives a clear prioritized plan.
